title: JPMorgan Transaction Event
description: Document model for transaction-event storage and operational investigation. Sample data is synthetic and does not represent actual JPMorgan Chase records.

account_id.description: Account identifier referencing the Oracle account record

customer_reference.description: Customer reference corresponding to the Oracle customer record

transaction_date.description: Transaction event timestamp in ISO 8601 format

amount.description: Non-negative monetary amount represented as a decimal string in this JSON model. MongoDB implementation uses BSON Decimal128.

channel.description: Channel through which the transaction was initiated

status.description: Current processing status of the transaction event

metadata.description: Embedded processing and channel-specific transaction details

source_system.description: System that originated or processed the event

destination_account_masked.description: Masked destination account identifier where applicable
